component: Calendar iTIP email transport failure boundary

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The temporary iTIP file helper removes its catch-and-null fallback, and its caller removes the if(mailFile) wrapper. Serialization or local file-write failure can therefore leave this call chain rather than becoming a false/no-file send result. The selected sendItems and outgoing helpers return the transport call without adding a catch. A normal path calls sendMessageFile and returns true; that is not delivery completion. The concrete filename is itipTemp. No file failure, cleanup result or mail send was exercised.
title: iTIP temporary-file creation now propagates failure instead of returning null
